name: evals-classify-service
description: Standalone encoder classification service for the evals platform's built-in signal heads.

comments-dependencies.onnxruntime-node: Direct dependency for embed.js's raw InferenceSession (last_hidden_state serving — no task pipeline exposes it). Pinned EXACTLY to the version @huggingface/transformers resolves so one native ONNX Runtime ships; bump the pin in lockstep with the transformers.js dependency.

comments.allowBuilds: The dependency-build-script allowlist lives in pnpm-workspace.yaml, not here: pnpm 11 removed the `pnpm` field in package.json and ignores it silently. onnxruntime-node/sharp/protobufjs all need their install scripts; without them the image builds clean and fails at model load.
